name: Kimaneki Nayuta
source:
The protagonist who's toppled by the harsh fate.

Being popular and loved by everyone — both male and female students, he has a past which he desires to forget.

Spending his peaceful life is a sin he carries—

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=931798&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
